title: NFL Player & His Girlfriend Act Entitled After DUI Crash
description:
On June 19th, 2024, officers responded to a crash site following reports of a Hyundai Tucson that had crashed into a restaurant. The driver was identified as a college football player for Cleveland Browns. Both him and his girlfriend denied medical assistance while refusing to cooperate. The female passenger didn’t give any solid answers to the crash investigation questions. The officers then tried collecting witness accounts to make sense of the incident. 
The male was very agitated and had watery, blood-shot eyes, droopy eyelids, and a strong odour of alcohol coming from his breath. After much confrontation the male reluctantly agreed to perform the field sobriety test. The male was acting ridiculous and kept throwing his hands in the air and rushing the officers to do what they had to do. The supervising officer had had enough of the suspect’s nuisance and he decided to intervene. The suspect claimed he could not count and eventually performed a casual stroll next to the line not even resembling what the officer instructed him to do. The suspect was taken to the Monroe County Sheriff’s Office Key West jail facility where he urinated on himself and declined to provide a breath sample. He was released by the Cleveland Browns following his arrest and was charged with driving under the influence causing property damage. Youtube thinks you’ll love the video on screen, click to watch now.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
